own_solution.law: Force on dielectric slab at constant voltage: F = (1/2) V^2 dC/dx, with C(x) = C0 [1 + (kappa-1) x/L]
assumptions: slab well inside the plate ends

notes: dC/dx = C0 (kappa-1)/L = 200e-12*3/0.10 = 6.0e-9 F/m; F = 0.5*500^2*6e-9 = 7.5e-4 N. With 850 V: F = 0.5*722500*6e-9 = 2.1675e-3 N. Insertion depth cancels from dC/dx (C), provided the slab edge stays away from the plate ends; 4.5 cm of 10 cm is consistent with 'well away from both ends'. Earlier-run and Geiger-supply batteries are D. Numeral-free 'small battery' sentences (T9C5B, T8F88) differ in carrying no number from their 350 V counterparts.
